title: Chapter 1873: Made By Your Subject (I)
content:
Chapter 1873: Made By Your Subject (I)

Spiritual qi surged amid drifting clouds and mist.

Brilliant light flickered among the toppled jade pillars, and translucent glow wafted over steps that seemed carved from white jade. Li Minggong reached the summit and turned slightly, a perfectly measured smile on her radiant face.

"Please wait a moment, my lord. The King of Wei will arrive shortly."

The solemn Daoist Master behind her wore green robes, with a gourd and a scroll hanging at his waist.

Sima Yuanli, Daoist Master Qinghu answered readily, "Of course... of course..."

After watching her descend, he began strolling around the mountain. He had visited more than once, but seldom had the leisure to appreciate the surroundings. In truth, the Li Family's Zhijing Mountain was hardly extraordinary. Even its formation was only in the Foundation Establishment Realm. Yet it possessed a distinctive elegance, displaying the composure and grandeur of a family that had risen amid troubled times.

Much like the woman who had just left.

He wandered, taking in the scenery. Rounding a bend, he noticed radiant light glimmering on the central pillar. Looking closely, he saw an inscription carved in bold, decisive strokes.

The walls of the desert city have fallen, making qi gathering especially difficult. Upon my death, heavenly light will gather, sand and dust will billow, and radiant origin will spill forth. I have therefore arranged a formation to contain it, that it may provide for those who come after.

Ximing, a descendant of the Li Family.

Sima Yuanli stared blankly for a moment, conflicting emotions stirring within him as understanding seemed to dawn. Only now did he realize how ignorant he had been when, presiding over his sect years ago, he had been so shaken by the news of Li Ximing's breakthrough.

Back then, I looked down upon the heroes of the world and thought them nothing special. Little did I know how many gifted souls lay hidden in the depths, staking their lives without a thought for themselves, all for the chance to leap!

So silent and unsettled was he that he did not immediately notice the young man walking through the air to stand upon the mountain. After a moment's daze, he turned, restoring the respectful smile to his face.

"Greetings, King of Wei!"

The young man seemed to have just emerged from seclusion. He slowly opened his golden eyes, within which flames could faintly be seen rising and flickering.

"No need for ceremony."

Sima Yuanli walked up to him with a smile, and Li Zhouwei said softly, "I asked you here to arrange two matters.

"First, I will be traveling to the Western Sea. Please inform the grand general and ask him to remain vigilant against Zhao and Shu."

Without Li Suining's confirmation, Li Zhouwei and Li Ximing could hardly have felt safe leaving Moongaze Lake at the same time. Even so, every necessary precaution still had to be taken.

"Second, I would borrow the [Huai River Map]."

Almost as soon as he spoke, Daoist Master Qinghu smoothly untied the scroll at his waist. Without the slightest hesitation or deliberation, he presented it to Li Zhouwei in both hands.

"I shall heed your commands, your highness."

Interest flickered in Li Zhouwei's golden eyes. He realized that the Daoist Master before him had long been prepared. Perhaps he had been waiting for the King of Wei to come and 'borrow' his [Huai River Map] ever since Guangchan's death!

Yet faced with such a supreme treasure of Bright Yang, those golden eyes held no trace of greed.

"Do not worry, Fellow Daoist Qinghu. Once the matter is settled, I will certainly return it. You will receive due compensation as well."

He casually accepted it, held it up before him in one hand, and gave it a gentle shake.

Whoosh!

The fine, silken cord binding the scroll immediately dissolved. A clear radiance shone forth, warm and gentle, as the spirit treasure revealed its true appearance!

A mighty river surged in endless, rolling swells. The brushstrokes unfolded like waves and flood dragons through the churning waters. It seemed less like a painting being unfurled than an expanse of boundless white opening before him. The roar of rushing rivers immediately filled the air. Then heavenly light flashed, and a mighty fortress rose, its towering walls standing amid the river, unmoved by all its fury.

Several lines of golden light appeared at the end of the scroll.

Sima Yuanli's gaze flickered. Alarm crossed his face as though he had seen something terrifying, and he quickly lowered his eyes to the ground. He had possessed this treasure for decades, and its inscription had always read,

[Huai River Map. Cui Yan of Boye. The three hundred and seventeenth year of Zhenghe.]

Black ink on white paper, perfectly clear and unmistakable. It was a True Monarch's own handwriting! For centuries upon centuries, it had never changed!

Yet as the King of Wei unfurled the scroll, dense golden patterns appeared along its edges for the first time. The golden characters of its closing inscription lit up one after another.

Huai River Map. Made by your subject Cui Yan in the three hundred and seventeenth year of Zhenghe.

————

Clouds and sky blended into one, radiant with light.

The darkness of the great void suddenly broke apart, spilling pale-yellow light. A Daoist stepped leisurely out, his robes and crown immaculate. Beneath his feet, Lesser Yang light shifted and swept obliquely, rolling in waves as he drifted to a halt above the sea.

He smiled and said, "Senior... This is the Western Sea!"

An old man hurried out behind him, his face a little pale. Riding the wind amid falling snow, he surveyed the surroundings with his somewhat clouded eyes. "I've spent my whole life in the Eastern Sea, but now I finally have the chance to see something new. I shall have to trouble you to show me around, fellow Daoist."

The Daoist Master who cultivated Lesser Yang smiled and shook his head. "You flatter me, senior. I've only been here once, accompanying a senior brother of my sect. I can hardly claim familiarity. We should simply follow Senior Zhaojing's arrangements."

These two were none other than Guo Nanwu and Yan Dushui!

After settling his arrangements, Li Ximing had traveled around the Western Sea, hoping to secure a few alchemy commissions. He had also sent a message asking Guo Nanwu to make a trip to the Eastern Sea.

Having Guo Nanwu handle this errand had given Yan Dushui quite a fright. The Guo Family had once taken refuge in the outer-sea. Yan Dushui's Western Curtain Sea was among the regions closest to it, so he actually knew Guo Nanwu!

I hear... he is practically a disciple of that Grand Daoist Master of Qusi.

At his age, Yan Dushui certainly knew of Mount Qusi! To put it bluntly, the immortal mountain was home to one of the foremost lineages in the entire Southern Sea, with hints of an ancient inheritance behind it. Though it could not compare with Nine Mounds, it was hardly far behind!

Guo Nanwu's standing was considerable, and certainly far above Yan Dushui's own. Having lived in seclusion for years, the elderly Daoist Master had asked Guo Nanwu for news throughout the journey. What he heard left him reeling.

Li Zhouwei has been granted the title of King of Wei... Has he already become so formidable?

By the end of the journey, his expression had grown solemn. He drifted down into the mountains and saw Li Ximing coming to welcome them.

His smile broadened as he hurriedly greeted, "Fellow Daoist Zhaojing, it has been a long time!"

Warm breezes stirred through the mountain. A pill furnace stood nearby, roaring flames dancing beneath it and casting shifting colors. Li Ximing looked over with a smile and exchanged a few pleasantries before surprise and concern entered his expression. "Senior Yan... these years of travel and toil have been hard on you!"

Li Ximing had seen Yan Dushui during his visit to Nine Mounds some years ago and thought him much older than at their first meeting. Time had passed swiftly, and now something had changed again.

Though the old man's face had changed little, Li Ximing immediately sensed something wrong when he activated his Fate Divine Ability and manifested the [Light of the Six Directions].

His vital radiance blazes beyond his body, and his divine abilities gleam and fluctuate within his six senses... He must be using some spirit item to cling to life... He has little time left!
